transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I've been feeling extremely depressed and sad for the past four months. I just feel this deep, constant emptiness inside that doesn't go away. It has been really hard to cope lately.
Have you experienced any periods of elevated mood, irritability, or increased energy over the past few years, even if they seemed minor or were pleasant at the time?

No, I've never experienced anything like that. My mood has been consistently low and depressed, and I haven't had any periods of feeling unusually high or energized. It has just been a constant state of sadness.
Have you experienced any unusual thoughts, heard voices, or seen things that others couldn't see during this period of feeling depressed?

Yes, since this depression started, I've begun hearing faint whispers when I'm completely alone in the room. I also get these strange thoughts, like feeling like I'm being watched or that random things around me have some hidden, unsettling meaning.
Did these unusual thoughts and hearing whispers start at the same time as your depressive symptoms, or did they begin before or after your depression started?

They only started after I fell into this deep depression about four months ago. I never experienced anything like that before my mood dropped. They really only seem to happen when I am feeling at my absolute lowest.
Do the whispers and strange thoughts completely go away when your depressive symptoms improve, even if only slightly, or do they persist regardless of your mood?

Yes, they completely go away when my mood improves even a little bit. They only happen when I am at my absolute lowest and feeling deeply depressed. When the darkness lifts slightly, the whispers and strange thoughts stop entirely.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where you had the strange thoughts or heard whispers without feeling depressed, or do they always occur together with your depressive episodes?
No, I've never had those strange thoughts or heard whispers without feeling depressed. They always occur together with my depression, and I've never experienced them when my mood was normal.

Can you recall any instance, even if brief, where you had a period of feeling relatively okay or even normal, but still experienced those strange thoughts or heard whispers, lasting for at least a few days?

No, I've never had those strange thoughts or heard voices during times when my mood felt okay or normal. They only ever happen when I am feeling deeply depressed. If my mood is stable, those experiences completely disappear.

Just to confirm, you're certain that the strange thoughts and whispers only occur when you're feeling depressed, and they completely stop when your mood improves, with no instances of experiencing them during periods of relatively normal mood, correct?

Yes, that's exactly right. The whispers and strange thoughts only happen when I am feeling deeply depressed, and they disappear completely when my mood lifts or feels normal. I've never experienced them during any period of feeling okay.

So, to summarize, your psychotic symptoms, such as the whispers and strange thoughts, are exclusively tied to your depressive episodes, and you've never experienced them outside of a depressive context, is that a correct understanding of your experience?

Yes, that is completely accurate and captures exactly what I've been going through. These strange thoughts and whispers only happen when I am feeling deeply depressed and down. I have never experienced them during times when my mood was normal or okay.
